theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenRep_divergence_integral_local_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn N)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet E volume → HasLocallyFinitePerimeter U E → ∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ K → ∀ M : ℝ, (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ M) → |∫ x in E ∩ U, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x| ≤ C * M
